cases.name: Nevaeh May Joslin Finch
cases.about: Her obituary said: "She grew up surrounded by people that loved her and raised her, Shelly Ryda, Shanon Olko and Joe McIntyre. Nevaeh graduated high school with full honors, ropes and awards. This was something she was very proud of, even displaying her ropes at her home. Nevaeh was extremely artistic and could draw effortlessly. She enjoyed reading, loving on her dog, NaNook and spending time with her family and friends. Nevaeh was extremely strong willed and always spoke her mind but was still compassionate, caring, kind and showed love in everything that she did. Her name spelled backwards is Heaven and she was the walking piece of Heaven on earth. This tragedy has rippled across so many people and her passing has left a void in the hearts of everyone who knew Nevaeh and loved her. She will be greatly missed."
